tasks.short: Observe patients and chart changes in condition.

steps.what: Observe patients for changes in conditions at the bedside.
Write adverse reactions just observed on the patient record.
Decide the necessary action for that medication or treatment.
Take the necessary action with those patients.
Report that change and the action to the registered nurse.
Draft the patient record charting line from the action.

loop.input: The observation note, the action decision, and the action taken. No microphone, and no medicine or dose she did not write.
loop.output: One chart sentence of the change and the action.
loop.check: The sentence states only a change written in the observation note and an action written in the action decision or the action taken. It adds no reaction, medicine, dose, or action she did not write.
loop.stop: One pass. If the sentence fails the check, or the observation note is blank, the draft stays blank and she writes the chart line.
loop.why_not_simpler: The observation is free text. A fixed template cannot phrase what she wrote, and a rule cannot tell a supported sentence from a line the note does not state.

steps.what: Check the patient record charting line cites the action.
File the confirmed charting line on the patient record.

tasks.design: She still observes the patient, writes what she saw, decides the action, takes it, and tells the registered nurse. {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, drafts one chart sentence from that note and that action, and stays blank if the sentence adds a reaction or an action she did not write. She checks the sentence before {OTHER} files it, and no microphone is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: The change was already written in a note, then typed again as a chart line.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can phrase one chart sentence from the note and the action she already wrote.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the change, and deciding the action when the note is thin.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the patient and knows whether the change needs action now.
tasks.altitude: She still observes, decides, acts and reports. The chart line she confirmed is the one on the record. She does not gain a right to prescribe.

reach.task: Read the confirmed chart line before changing the plan
reach.learn: Read the confirmed line, not the draft. A blank draft means she has not charted that change.

evidence.claim: A chart line of a change often repeats an observation the nurse has already written.
Autoscriber summarises consultations into ChipSoft HiX.
In Dutch general practice an ambient scribe was associated with 42.7 seconds less documentation per consultation, and consultation length was unchanged.
An ambient-scribe study in Dutch general practice reports inaccurate summaries and patients holding back sensitive information.
The medical dossier is kept twenty years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.
Software with a medical purpose is a medical device.
Health data are a special category.
Large-scale processing of health data needs a data-protection impact assessment.
Recording consultations or logging corrections can count as staff monitoring.

assumptions: The observation note in s2 is her own writing of what she just saw. The loop uses only that note, the action decision, and the action taken. It does not use a microphone and it does not record the room.
A blank draft means she writes the chart line herself and the filing step does not run. A later change to the note or the action voids the confirmed sentence.
The chart line is not a prescription and does not change the order.
The 0.8 hours are a monthly sample of filed lines, looking for a reaction or an action the note does not state.
The published 42.7 seconds are not this task's saving. Where the digest names Dutch dossier rules, that retention applies; elsewhere national rules apply.
unknowns: Whether charting on this ward is still a second typing of a note she already wrote.
Whether the observation note is stored on the electronic patient record or only in a pocket note.
research_questions: On this ward, what share of chart lines repeats an observation note written the same shift?

already_counted.description: Reading the draft against the observation note and the action.

incremental.description: Monthly sample of filed chart lines for a reaction or an action the note does not state.

approvals.approved_version: The chart sentence she confirmed, stating only a change written in the observation note and an action written in the action decision or the action taken. A blank draft is not filed. A later change to the note or the action voids this binding.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the second writing of a chart line already in her note is drafted, and only the filing of the confirmed sentence is configured. Observing, the note, the decision, the action and the report to the nurse stay at full time. A thin note leaves the draft blank, so she writes the line. The published consultation-time study is not this task's figure.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure and record patients' vital signs.

steps.what: Measure the patients' height, weight, temperature, blood pressure, pulse and respiration.
Record those vital signs once on the patient record.
Drop the recopied paper chart of those vital signs.
Flag a vital sign outside the ward range on the patient record.
Decide whether that vital sign needs a nurse called.
Tell the registered nurse the vital sign that was flagged.

tasks.design: She still measures each vital sign and enters it once on {OTHER}, the electronic patient record. The paper line of those same numbers is dropped, and {OTHER} only flags a value outside the ward range the registered nurse already stored. She still decides whether to call, and she still makes the call.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same vital numbers were written on paper and then typed again.
tasks.enabler_now: One entry on the record can be the only copy, and a stored range can mark a value outside it.
tasks.still_hard: Taking the measurement, and judging a reading when no range is stored.
tasks.human_edge: She is with the patient and sees whether a number matches how the patient looks.
tasks.altitude: She still measures and still decides whether to call. The paper copy of numbers already on the record is what goes.

reach.learn: Store measure name, low, high and unit. A missing range leaves the flag blank.

evidence.claim: Vital signs are measured at the bedside and the numbers are then written on the chart. A paper line can repeat numbers already entered.
The medical dossier is kept twenty years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.
Health data are a special category.

assumptions: She types the vital set in s2: patient id, measure name, value, unit and time. Those numbers come from the measurement she just took. No transmitting cuff is assumed. The paper drop uses only that entry. If she has not entered the set, the paper line is not dropped.

The ward vital range is a prior contract with fields measure name, low, high and unit. The producer is the registered nurse who owns the ward protocol, stored before this task. That capture is not counted as time saved here. If no range is stored, the flag stays blank and she decides in s5 at full time.
The flag is a view. It does not call anyone and it does not store a decision.
The 0.5 hours are one confirmation when the ward changes a range. A week with no paper chart saves almost nothing on the dropped line.
unknowns: Whether this ward still keeps a paper vital chart beside the record.
Whether a range is already stored per measure.
research_questions: What share of vital-sign entries on this ward is written twice, on paper and on the record?

already_counted.description: Judging an out-of-range flag against the patient.

incremental.description: When the ward changes a range, she confirms the new limits once.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the second paper writing of numbers she has already entered is dropped, and only a stored range is compared. Measuring, the entry, the decision and telling the nurse stay at full time. A week with no paper chart, or with no stored range, saves almost nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give prescribed medicines and note times and amounts.

steps.what: Read the prescribed medications or intravenous fluids on the patient record.
Check the patients, dose and time against that prescribed order.
Administer the prescribed medications or start the intravenous fluids.
Note the times and amounts on the patient record.
Drop the recopied charts of those times and amounts.
Tell the patients which medications were given.

tasks.design: She still reads the order, checks the patient, the dose and the time, gives the medicine or starts the fluid, and tells the patient. {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, keeps the time and the amount she notes, and the paper chart of those same figures is dropped. She does not change the order.
tasks.previous_blocker: The time and the amount were written on the chart after they were already noted.
tasks.enabler_now: The note on the record can be the only copy of the time and the amount.
tasks.still_hard: Checking the order against the patient, and giving the dose.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person who checks the patient and gives the dose.
tasks.altitude: She still checks and still gives the dose. The paper copy of a time and an amount already noted is what goes. She does not prescribe.

reach.task: Confirm the assignment for a reserved act
reach.learn: The order and the assignment stay with the prescriber and the registered nurse. A missing order means the dose is not given.

evidence.claim: The nurse gives a dose that was already prescribed and notes the time and the amount on the chart.
Dutch pharmacy systems run G-Standaard surveillance for interactions, contra-indications and dose, with KNMP minimum settings.
Ionising radiation is a reserved act; other acts are done on assignment with instructions.
The medical dossier is kept twenty years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.
Health data are a special category.

assumptions: The prescription order is a prior contract with fields patient id, drug or fluid name, dose, unit, route, scheduled time and prescriber. The producer is the prescribing practitioner, on the patient record, in another task. That capture is not counted as time saved here. If the order is not on the record, she does not give the dose and she writes nothing.
She types the administration note in s4: patient id, drug or fluid name, amount, unit, time and route. The paper drop uses only that note. If the note was not entered, the paper line is not dropped.
Interaction surveillance already ran on the order before it reached her. She does not re-run it, and that earlier check is not her saving. She still checks the patient, the dose and the time.

She gives the dose on the prescriber's order and the registered nurse's assignment. She does not prescribe. The digest's reserved-act example is ionising radiation; this task adds no right to perform a reserved act.
The 0.4 hours are a weekly look for a dose whose paper line was the only copy anyone could find.
unknowns: Whether this ward still keeps a paper medicine chart.
Whether she may note a dose without a second signature.
research_questions: What share of administered doses on this ward is written both on paper and on the record?

incremental.description: A weekly look at notes whose paper line was the only copy anyone could find.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the second paper writing of a time and an amount she has already noted is dropped. Reading the order, the check, giving the dose and telling the patient stay at full time. A ward that no longer keeps a paper chart saves nothing on this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer patients' calls and decide how to assist.

steps.what: Answer patients' calls on the nurse-call at bedside.
Determine how to assist them from what they ask.
Assist the patients with the need just determined.
Write the assistance given on the patient record.
Place the nurse-call time on the patient record note.

tasks.design: She still answers, decides and assists in person. She writes what she did on {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, and {OTHER} places the nurse-call time the bell already stored onto that note. No chatbot answers the call, and the call is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The time of the call was copied by hand onto a note of help she had already given.
tasks.enabler_now: The nurse-call system already stores the bed and the time when the patient presses.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing what the patient needs, and doing the assistance.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the patient and decides what help is safe.
tasks.altitude: She still answers and still assists. The clock time is the only thing she stops copying. She does not hand the call to a chatbot.

reach.task: Read the assistance note after a call that needs a plan change
reach.learn: Read the note she confirmed. A call with no bell time is still her written note.

evidence.claim: Answering a patient's call is a bedside conversation, and the assistance is given in person.
Patient chatbots disclose that they are AI from 2 August 2026.
The medical dossier is kept twenty years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.
Health data are a special category.
Recording consultations or logging corrections can count as staff monitoring.

assumptions: The call stamp is a prior contract with fields bed id, call time and press event. The producer is the nurse-call system at the moment the patient presses. That capture is not her labour and is not counted as time saved. If the bell has no time, she writes the time inside the assistance note and the attach step does not run.
She writes the assistance note before the call time is attached. The approved version is that note plus the bell's stored bed id and call time. A later edit to the assistance text voids the binding.
She answers in person. No chatbot is opened, and the call is not recorded. The bell log used here is a timestamp only.
The 0.3 hours are the calls, about one in twenty, where a failed bell makes her write the time by hand. That writing sits in the assistance note, which stays at full time.
unknowns: Whether this ward's nurse-call system already stores bed id and call time.
Whether assistance notes are filed on the patient record or only in a ward book.
research_questions: Does the nurse-call system on this ward already store a time for each press?

already_counted.description: She writes the assistance and looks at the call time before it is attached.

incremental.description: When a bell fails she writes the time by hand, about one call in twenty.

approvals.approved_version: The assistance note she just wrote, with the bed id and call time already stored for that nurse-call press. If the bell has no time, this write does not run. A later edit to the assistance note voids this binding.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only copying the clock time from the bell log is configured. Answering, deciding, assisting and writing what she did stay at full time. A bell with no time, or a week of calls she does not chart, saves nothing. No chatbot is used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still observes, measures, gives medicines on the order she was given, and answers calls. Confirmed chart lines and assistance notes keep her check. She does not prescribe and she does not hand a call to a chatbot.
reach: The registered nurse reads the confirmed chart line and the assistance note, not the draft, before changing the plan.
The prescribing practitioner's order stays the authority for a dose. A missing order means the dose is not given.
skills_to_grow: Leave a chart sentence blank when the observation note does not state it.
Enter each vital sign once, and do not recopy it onto paper.
Write the assistance herself, and let only a stored call time be attached.
role.ambitious_version: Each change she has already written, each vital set she has entered, and each call she has assisted has one confirmed note. She still observes, measures, checks and assists. Nothing is filed that she did not write or check.

job.title: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
